title: INI-style config with defaults and typed getters
source: Authored for the CodeReview benchmark corpus (generation-v3 clean-authored stratum), 2026-11-05
false_flag_note: A reviewer might flag get_int/get_bool raising instead of returning the fallback for a present-but-malformed value. That distinction is the contract: fallbacks apply only to absent keys, while a malformed value the operator actually wrote must surface loudly rather than be silently replaced.
